Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story
At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview
We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish
In your first 6 months, you’ll…
• 
Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design
• 
Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear
• 
Run research from early discovery through usability testing
• 
Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.
• 
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process
• 
Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…
• 
Build deeper ownership across the IRL product
• 
Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows
• 
Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning
• 
Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering
• 
Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…
• 
You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction
• 
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work
• 
You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states
• 
You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI
• 
You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process
• 
You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions
• 
You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn
• 
You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With
• 
2–5 years working in product design
• 
Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction
• 
Running user research from discovery through usability testing
• 
Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions
• 
Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams
• 
Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states
• 
Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions
• 
Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve
• 
Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output
• 
A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value
At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

• 
Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.
• 
Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.
• 
Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.
• 
Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.
• 
Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team
Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:
• 
Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership
• 
Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context
• 
Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process
• 
Recruiter Screen
• 
Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager
• 
Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering
• 
Final leadership conversation
• 
Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits
• 
Base Salary: $100K–$129K
• 
Fully remote, US-based team
• 
Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
• 
Co-working or home office stipend
• 
Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation
• 
Education and learning support
• 
Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

Headquarters: Remote - MX

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
The Opportunity 

Are you a data-driven lifecycle marketer with a passion for customer engagement and the technical chops to strengthen and scale customer lifecycle marketing capabilities? We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our powerhouse team and lead lifecycle strategy and execution across Oportun's product ecosystem and key member moments. You will define and execute programs across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels to drive activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

You are responsible for both strategy and execution. This includes prioritizing lifecycle initiatives across products, ensuring campaigns run reliably, and continuously improving performance through testing, segmentation, personalization, and marketing technology enhancements. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Marketing Technology to deliver timely, compliant, and effective communications. You will also manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and translate business needs into clear data, platform, and execution requirements.

This role will also help advance Oportun's CLM technology capabilities. You will identify and implement opportunities such as new channel expansion, custom event integrations, improved customer data flows, AI-assisted campaign workflows, and automation that makes the CLM program more scalable, personalized, and efficient.

Success in this role means improving key lifecycle metrics across products, building scalable systems, strengthening CLM platform capabilities, and ensuring lifecycle marketing is a reliable, tech-enabled growth lever for the business.

If you're a hands-on marketer with a passion for strategic thinking, lifecycle marketing execution, data-driven decision-making, marketing technology, and customer engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll own and optimize the lifecycle roadmap across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, product adoption, and cross-product growth.

• You’ll build, launch, and optimize multi-channel campaigns across email, push, SMS, in-app, and emerging channels.

• You’ll use customer data, behavioral signals, product events, segmentation, and personalization to deliver timely and relevant member experiences.

• You’ll design and improve automated lifecycle journeys that support onboarding, activation, feature adoption, servicing, engagement, and retention.

• You’ll lead structured experimentation, including A/B and holdout testing, to measure incremental impact and improve performance.

• You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data, Design, Content, Legal, Compliance, and Marketing Technology to align priorities and deliver new capabilities.

• You’ll translate lifecycle needs into clear technical requirements, event definitions, data requirements, use cases, and implementation priorities.

• You’ll help advance Oportun’s CLM technology capabilities through new channels, custom events, improved data flows, platform enhancements, and automation.

• You’ll identify and resolve gaps in data, tooling, integrations, or workflows that limit campaign performance or execution.

• You’ll ensure campaigns meet high standards for QA, deliverability, consent management, data integrity, privacy, compliance, and member experience.

• You’ll bring ideas for how we can do things better, proactively, not just when asked.

• You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve campaign development, analysis, personalization, QA, reporting, and workflow efficiency.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a customer-focused lifecycle marketer who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting into the details of execution. You combine strong marketing judgment with data, technology, and experimentation to improve member experiences and business outcomes.

You’re proactive, accountable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You know how to influence across teams, translate business needs into actionable requirements, and maintain a high bar for quality in a regulated environment.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• 5+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, or customer engagement marketing.

• Hands-on experience building and optimizing lifecycle programs using Iterable or a similar marketing automation platform such as Braze, Marketo, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

• Strong knowledge of multi-channel lifecycle execution across email, push, SMS, in-app messaging, segmentation, automation, personalization, and deliverability.

• Strong technical proficiency with HTML, CSS, and dynamic scripting or templating languages such as AMPscript, Handlebars, Liquid, or similar.

• Proven experience improving lifecycle performance through automation, segmentation, personalization, and structured experimentation.

• Experience partnering with technical teams on event-based triggers, data requirements, integrations, customer data flows, or platform capabilities.

• Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests, holdouts, and incrementality measurement.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate campaign and customer data into actionable business decisions.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands and manage cross-functional dependencies.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.

• Familiarity with APIs, custom events, event-based architectures, and customer data pipelines.

• Experience using SQL or similar tools for campaign analysis, segmentation, or troubleshooting.

• Experience applying AI tools to campaign development, personalization, QA, reporting, workflow automation, or customer insights.

• Experience evaluating or implementing new CLM channels, platform capabilities, or marketing technology enhancements.

• Experience working across multiple products or complex customer journeys.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you 

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: 

Mexico Benefits: 

Medical Insurance
Savings Fund
Life Insurance
Internet and Electricity Allowance
Paid time off, such as vacation and parental leave

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers  #LI-REMOTE …

Experience working on frontend and backend components of web applications.

Experience developing and maintaining RESTful APIs.
